mentions.name: WhatsApp expert advice service
mentions.description: This service connects people directly with experts over WhatsApp for advice, starting with an insurance broker with far shorter response times to help people choose coverage, with plans to expand to other topics such as immigration law.
mentions.problem: People choosing insurance need direct expert advice, which is provided with far shorter response times via WhatsApp.
mentions.source_excerpt: At the same time, I'm testing a new insurance broker with far shorter response times, so people can directly ask an expert to help them choose. They're reachable via Whatsapp, and that made a huge difference in how people get advice. It worked so well that I want to do the same for other topics. I'm already talking with an immigration lawyer who's interested.
